# Zeus Angelo Bautista — Portfolio

> Personal portfolio and software engineering showcase of Zeus Angelo Bautista, IT Developer and AI Engineer.

## Overview
- Developer: Zeus Angelo Bautista
- Role: IT Developer & AI Engineer
- Education: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology, Major in Mobile and Web Applications (BSIT-MWA)
- Philosophy: Kaizen (改善) — Continuous improvement in habits, code, and systems.

## Featured Projects
- TalkTics: Multimodal AI public speaking coach with real-time MediaPipe vision mesh and Librosa acoustic analytics (https://bigkas.site/)
- L.I.N.N.Y: Enterprise-grade Python desktop voice assistant and smart home IoT suite (https://github.com/kidlatpogi/L.I.N.N.Y)
- Saddle Ranch: Enterprise restaurant platform with real-time KDS, POS, and QR ordering (https://saddle-ranch-web.onrender.com/)
- WhatDayIsIt: Lightweight, ambient Windows desktop calendar widget connected to Google Calendar (https://github.com/kidlatpogi/WhatDayIsIt)
- Web-Tools: Curated developer arsenal and CS student toolkit (https://wtoolz.vercel.app/)
- Olympus: Centralized algorithmic vault and multi-language code repository (https://github.com/kidlatpogi/Olympus)
